Ratspeak Handheld beta for T-Deck Plus and T-Pager, combining rsDeck and rsPager
with a Rust Reticulum/LXMF core. Networking and storage run separately from the
interface. Cardputer Adv remains in testing.

For the launcher and both modes, download `rsdeck-full.zip` or `rspager-full.zip`
and upload it to the [web flasher](https://ratspeak.org/download.html#dl-custom).
The `*-standalone.zip` and `*-rnode.zip` packages install one mode only.

These are fresh-install packages, not data-preserving updates. Back up before
flashing, including when Full Erase is off. There is no automatic migration from
rsDeck or rsPager. The [installation guide](https://docs.ratspeak.org/docs/hardware/flashing-firmware#before-flashing)
covers backups, rollback and importing an existing identity key.

The separate application `.bin` files are for launcher or layout-specific use,
not the normal web-flasher upload. Source, checksums and license notices are
included with this release.
